parityQueries: Reuse all 154 previously scored shifted-window threshold questions.

policies.cold: Use the earlier endpoint-first scan with per-query verified packed chunks.
policies.flatIndex: Verify and load the entire sorted change-point file, use the next change to classify each window, and stop when the threshold is settled.
policies.sizeGuard: Use cold if the index payload alone is at least the full packed footprint of the relevant post-start windows. Otherwise use the index.
policies.sharedBatch: For each region, also compare one reusable source chunk cache with one verified index shared over all its queries.

criterion: Match independent direct counts with the frozen decoder and windows. Verify restored index and packed bytes, charge one index verification record per invocation, and distinguish per-query payload from region-batch reuse. A change point must lie strictly after the window start and at or before the endpoint.
